note: Words on each new-face screen's first view (ADR-069 #4, ADR-072 #9, ADR-077 #3, ADR-078 #5), counted as the prototype counted them: a word has a letter; numbers and {placeholders} are not words. Budgets are the prototype's targets (prototip/yeni-yuz.html, each screen's t:); copy-budget.test.ts holds the table to the prototype and every built screen to its budget. task: the backlog task that builds the screen; once it is done the screen must list its keys. file: the screen's route file; every copy key it uses is in keys or in notFirstView. keys: the copy keys of the first view; dynamic: words no key holds (a date the phone writes, 'Mon, Oct 19' is 2), each with what it is; a list inside the list is one of several texts shown in the same place, and the longest counts. Legal lines (Terms, Privacy, Restore, Account) go in notFirstView: ADR-072 #9 leaves them out. uncounted: on the first view but not counted, as the prototype marks them data-nc (the user's own words such as a day's name, and short marks such as weekday chips).
ruleShortNote: The longest a reason's short line may be (decision.ruleShort.<rule>, K-1000, ADR-077 Ek 4): the call screen (45 words) holds two of them beside the label, the line, the changes and the buttons. RuleShortLinesTests holds every line to it, counting as above.

The first view is the first day's: the title, the four meals with their calories, the search (it searches as you type, ADR-085) with its barcode icon, Quick add and Create food, and the tray of the chosen meal with its way to the day; nothing else is offered when there is no past meal and no recent food. Evre 7 A (ADR-090 Ek 6) rebuilt the screen: the four lists (Recent, Frequent, Favorites, Log again) became one list with sections, shown in the face below, and the food rows carry the macros as marks (P, C, F) and a single calorie number; food names, brands and the portion of a row are the database's and the person's own words, listed as dynamic. The plus on a row, the heart and the barcode icon are spoken, not read. The budget is unchanged. K1 (openly): Evre 7 A raised the budget from 40 to 50, and the prototype's target with it (prototip/yeni-yuz.html, meal t: 50): the ordinary day's face now offers a past meal, Favorites, the foods usually had at this meal and the recent ones in one list, each row with its macros, which the four hidden tabs of K-1063 did not show at once.
